chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch 22: The Way Out — A Hollow Victory at Dawn
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang kills Danyangzi but finds no joy—only a silent temple, freed prisoners scattering into the dawn, and a lonely choice to walk back into the dark.
og_title: The Sunrise That Means Nothing — Chapter 22 of Dao Gui Yi Xian
og_description: Danyangzi is dead. Everyone runs for the light. Li Huowang walks back into the cave. New Year’s Day has never felt so hollow.
twitter_title: He won. He’s free. So why does he go back?
twitter_description: Li Huowang kills his master, frees the prisoners, then turns and walks alone into the dark temple. Victory never tasted so empty.
